newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria's Assad makes first appearance after surgery.
newsitem.headline: Syria's Assad makes first appearance after surgery.

text.p: Syrian President Hafez al-Assad on Tuesday made his first public appearance after a prostate surgery which was announced two weeks ago, his spokesman said.
He said Assad, 66, visited the grave of his eldest son, Basel, in Qardaha, some 350 km (220 miles) northwest of Damascus.
He said the president, accompanied by his wife, laid a wreath on the tomb of his son who died in a car accident exactly three years ago.
